messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (gateway errors + timeouts). 90s rolling spike, 8% error rate > threshold. Paging ryan_oncall
ryan_oncall: on it, grabbing logs and looking at dashboards :eyes:
jen_sre: what error codes exactly? 502/504/503? any region skew?
ryan_oncall: mostly 502 and 504, a few 500s. US-west is worst, latency also up ~300ms p50 -> 600ms p50
mike_runtime: tagging runtime — will check KV/prefix cache layer. Last deploy to runtime was 12:03 UTC, but no config changes since yesterday.
eva_support: CX ticket spike — customers reporting 502s during inference calls. Linda, forwarding top customers to notify if impact confirmed.
linda_cs: thanks, holding message drafts. want to know affected percent before sending.
ryan_oncall: quick checks: backend pods are healthy but many cache-miss counters jumped and prefix_cache_evictions spiked. attaching quick snippet from metrics:
```
prefix_cache_evictions_total{shard="s3"} 15823
prefix_cache_misses_total 124512
kv_corruption_errors_total 42
```

ryan_oncall: also seeing repeated `KV fetch timeout` in logs from runtime shards 3-5.
jen_sre: that aligns with 504s. suspect an eviction storm or a corrupted KV entry causing retries/timeouts. Any recent model rollouts that changed prefix distribution?
mike_runtime: No model rollouts. But yesterday we enabled aggressive LRU for prefix cache on canary to save mem. Could be related — config `prefix_cache.max_entries` was lowered from 500k -> 150k.
eng-ml: that change was limited to canary, but config rollout might have leaked — checking config push logs.

deploy-bot: config-push: prefix-cache-policy updated by mike_runtime at 2024-05-14T12:02:11Z -> rolled to 10% of runtime fleet
mike_runtime: oh right, 10% canary. should not affect majority. but if canary ended up behind load balancer subset, could be hot shard.
ryan_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily disable prefix cache eviction (set to conservative LRU) on affected shards 3-6; 2) route traffic away from those pods if they don't recover; 3) trigger targeted prefix-cache flush and KV consistency check; 4) increase KV RPC timeout to reduce 504s; 5) update customer-facing status if impact >5% sustained.
eva_support: good. Linda can we prepare the “investigating” note?
linda_cs: drafting now, will wait 10m for numbers.
jen_sre: can someone run the targeted cache disable? mike/r yan you have runbook?
mike_runtime: running command to set policy on shard 3,4,5,6: ```
# set conservative policy
curl -X POST "http://runtime-admin/shards/3/cache/policy" -d '{"max_entries":450000,"eviction":"conservative"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN"
```

mike_runtime: applying to shard 3... ok. shard 4... applying... shard 5 responses flaky, retrying.
ryan_oncall: while that runs, I'll move 30% traffic off nodes with high eviction via routing weight: `routectl set-weight --group runtime-us-west --weight 70`

deploy-bot: traffic-shift: started shifting 30% off runtime-us-west at 12:19:40Z
jen_sre: also bump kv RPC timeout from 200ms -> 600ms for a short window to absorb retries: ```
runtime.config.kv_rpc_timeout_ms: 600
```

mike_runtime: shard 5 responded after second attempt, config applied. shard 6 didn't accept — seeing `kv: checksum mismatch` in logs for shard 6, possible corruption.
ryan_oncall: quarantine shard 6 from serving immediately. `routectl disable-shard --shard=6`

mike_runtime: shard 6 disabled. starting KV consistency job on shard 6 and scheduled restart.
eng-ml: curious if specific prefixes are malformed; logs show a repeated key `prefix:org:abc123` failing decode. Might be a corruption in KV store.
ryan_oncall: if it's a corrupted prefix key causing decode path to throw and cache eviction storm, quarantining and failing over should fix the 502/504s quickly.

jen_sre: monitoring graphs — error rate dropping from 8% -> 3.1% after traffic shift & shard quarantine :thumbsup: keep an eye for regressions.

linda_cs: draft ready to send to customers: "We're investigating elevated 5xx rates affecting inference requests in US-West. We have mitigations underway and will update in 30 minutes." Approve?
eva_support: send now, include expected next update time.
linda_cs: sent.
ryan_oncall: running KV consistency check output tail: ```
[2024-05-14T12:27:10Z] shard=6 verify: checksum mismatch for key prefix:org:abc123
[2024-05-14T12:27:11Z] shard=6 repair: skipping corrupted key and marking tombstone
[2024-05-14T12:27:12Z] shard=6 status: repair complete, 1 corrupted key skipped
```

mike_runtime: after repair, restarting runtime process on shard 6. will bring back to warm pool then route traffic gradually.
ryan_oncall: once shard 6 warmed, set route weight +5% every 2m while watching 5xxs.
jen_sre: post-mitigation metrics look stable: p50 latency down to baseline, 5xx ~0.8% now.
eng-ml: recommend we add a KV-level checksum alert and a canary config guard to prevent aggressive LRU from rolling wide.
mike_runtime: agreed. I'll open a PR to add deploy-time gating and revert the canary policy change.

linda_cs: customer update sent: "Impact reduced; full mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary"
ryan_oncall: incident severity: S2 (partial outage) for now. Owners: ryan_oncall, jen_sre, mike_runtime. Postmortem owner: eng-ml. ETA to initial summary 3h.
j en_sre: follow-up actions I created in ticket: add KV corruption alert, add config gate for cache policies, add graceful degradation path to bypass prefix cache for hot prefixes.

mike_runtime: closing immediate mitigations — shard quarantine + config changes resolved the storm. Leaving monitoring to run for 2h before declaring resolved.

incident-bot: incident-note: created INC-2024-1587, severity=S2, owners=[ryan_oncall,jen_sre,mike_runtime], start_ts=1719994321
ryan_oncall: thanks everyone. I'll hand off to the next oncall at 15:00 UTC with notes, and write the timeline for postmortem. Please add any missing notes here. :beers:
